# ChinaRhinestone.com

> Custom heat transfer manufacturer in Yiwu, China (est. 2018). We produce rhinestone, silicone, reflective, DTF, 3D, PU and specialty heat transfers in bulk for garment manufacturers worldwide — sportswear, workwear, fashion apparel, activewear and teamwear. Services: custom development, color matching, sampling, bulk production, QC and repeat-order supply. Quote within 24 hours.

Key facts: Founded 2018 in Yiwu, Zhejiang, China · 5,000+ B2B clients · 50M+ stones monthly capacity · 30+ countries served · Free online rhinestone design tool at /designer.html

## Heat Transfer Technologies

- [Rhinestone Heat Transfers](https://chinarhinestone.com/heat-transfers/rhinestone-heat-transfers): Custom sparkling transfers with a free online design tool
- [Silicone Heat Transfers](https://chinarhinestone.com/heat-transfers/silicone-heat-transfers): Soft, stretchable, raised transfers for performance apparel
- [Reflective Heat Transfers](https://chinarhinestone.com/heat-transfers/reflective-heat-transfers): High-visibility logos and safety markings
- [DTF Heat Transfers](https://chinarhinestone.com/heat-transfers/dtf-heat-transfers): Full-color digital transfers with photo-quality detail
- [3D & Raised Heat Transfers](https://chinarhinestone.com/heat-transfers/3d-raised-heat-transfers): Dimensional effects with sharp edges
- [PU Heat Transfers](https://chinarhinestone.com/heat-transfers/pu-heat-transfers): Thin, clean-edged, cost-effective logos
- [Glitter Heat Transfers](https://chinarhinestone.com/heat-transfers/glitter-heat-transfers): Sparkle effects for fashion apparel
- [Flock Heat Transfers](https://chinarhinestone.com/heat-transfers/flock-heat-transfers): Soft velvet-textured finishes
- [Specialty Heat Transfers](https://chinarhinestone.com/heat-transfers/specialty-heat-transfers): Metallic, holographic, glow-in-the-dark finishes
